ui.chat.bridgeReceipt.received.note: Sender is trusted display metadata, never a routing ID or parsed envelope.

placeholders.sender: Display name of the sender, not an account ID.

ui.chat.bridgeReceipt.unavailable.note: Missing admitted body is unavailable; this does not imply moderation failure.

ui.chat.bridgeReceipt.provenance.note: One subtle provenance label; never replaces model-context untrusted guidance.

ui.chat.bridgeReceipt.loading.note: Shown while the card asks the local backend for the admitted body. Ellipsis is one character.

ui.chat.bridgeReceipt.pending.note: The message reached this computer but has not been handed to the agent yet (that happens at its next turn, often minutes or hours later); the open card updates by itself when it is. Neutral, not an error. Same words as core tui.bridge_card.body.pending and relay.transcript.bridge.pending.

ui.chat.bridgeReceipt.held.note: Moderation is holding the message for a person to review; it may still be released or refused, and the open card updates by itself. Never name a reason or category.

ui.chat.bridgeReceipt.held_transient.note: Screening has not run yet or the message is still being delivered; nothing was decided. Never imply moderation acted. Same words as core tui.bridge_card.body.held_transient.

ui.chat.bridgeReceipt.refused.note: Moderation refused the message for this agent. Terminal; never name a reason.

ui.chat.bridgeReceipt.not_admitted.note: The message was never handed to this agent's turn, so no body was kept.

ui.chat.bridgeReceipt.unavailable_reason.role: Incoming Bridge body unavailable: signed out
ui.chat.bridgeReceipt.unavailable_reason.note: Reader must sign in to Team Bridge so an older body can be loaded from the hub. 'Team Bridge' is a product name; do not translate.

ui.chat.bridgeReceipt.unavailable_reason.role: Incoming Bridge body unavailable: other account
ui.chat.bridgeReceipt.unavailable_reason.note: The card belongs to a different Team Bridge account than the one signed in now.

ui.chat.bridgeReceipt.unavailable_reason.role: Incoming Bridge body unavailable: not a member
ui.chat.bridgeReceipt.unavailable_reason.note: The reader left or was removed from the conversation.
The sender or an admin deleted the message.

ui.chat.bridgeReceipt.unavailable_reason.role: Incoming Bridge body unavailable: hub cannot backfill
ui.chat.bridgeReceipt.unavailable_reason.note: The hub cannot return this older message's body.

Radient (the hub) could not be reached to load this message's body. The open card keeps trying by itself, so do not tell the reader to close or reopen anything. 'Radient' is a product name; do not translate.

ui.chat.bridgeReceipt.show_more.note: Button under a collapsed long message body.

ui.chat.bridgeReceipt.show_less.note: Button under an expanded long message body.

ui.chat.bridgeReceipt.more.note: One card can stand for many messages; only the first 20 are listed and this counts the rest. Use the locale's plural categories.

placeholders.count: Number of further messages in this card that are not listed.

ui.chat.bridgeReceipt.thread_reply.note: Shown in the open card's headline after the sender and conversation, joined by ' · ', when the message is a reply inside a thread rather than a top-level post. Short noun phrase, no final punctuation.
